claims.text: Role in cor pulmonale: tx is directed at the cause;
claims.quote: Treatment of right heart failure consists of identifying and treating the underlying cause.
claims.locator: Treatment of Right Heart Failure and Cor Pulmonale › Treatment of cause

claims.text: acute causes incl massive pulmonary embolization.
When the cause is acute PE: initial, then maintenance anticoagulation is indicated (prevents further embolization and new clot);
claims.quote: Initial anticoagulation followed by maintenance anticoagulation is indicated for patients with acute pulmonary embolism to prevent further embolization as well as new clot formation.

claims.text: initial choices incl factor Xa inhibitors (oral apixaban, edoxaban or rivaroxaban, or SC fondaparinux);
claims.quote: Factor Xa inhibitors (oral apixaban, edoxaban, or rivaroxaban, or subcutaneous fondaparinux)

claims.text: in PE w severe cardiopulmonary decompensation, use parenteral anticoagulants until cardiopulmonary function improves significantly.
claims.quote: The safety and efficacy of these medications in patients with PE complicated by severe cardiopulmonary decompensation have not been studied, and parenteral medications should be used for anticoagulation in these patients until there is significant improvement in cardiopulmonary function.

claims.text: Azole antifungals and protease inhibitors raise oral Xa inhibitor levels; certain antiseizure drugs and RIF lower them.
claims.quote: azole antifungal therapy and protease inhibitors will increase oral factor Xa inhibitor levels, and certain antiseizure medications and rifampin will decrease oral factor Xa inhibitor levels

claims.text: Reversal: andexanet alfa (Andexxa) was indicated for life-threatening or uncontrolled bleed on rivaroxaban or apixaban;
claims.quote: ANDEXXA is indicated for patients treated with rivaroxaban or apixaban, when reversal of anticoagulation is needed due to life-threatening or uncontrolled bleeding.
Andexxa will no longer be manufactured for or sold in the U.S. by AstraZeneca after December 22, 2025.

claims.text: If andexanet alfa = unavailable, 4-factor PCC may be considered.
claims.quote: If andexanet alfa is unavailable, 4-factor prothrombin complex concentrate may be considered.
claims.locator: Bleeding During Use of Anticoagulants: Anticoagulant reversal
